evidence.detail: The class is a synthetic child of the already-reviewed rs/l/e/a/h HalloweenEventChestOverlay; its constructor takes only that parent and no other exact-v308 owner constructs it.
HalloweenEventChestOverlay registers this callback on exact widget id 60612 through the ClientOverlay widget-callback registry during construction.

The callback activates only while the parent overlay flag is set and widget az[1] is positive, then draws the shared decoration renderer four times around the widget at fixed corner offsets; it owns no packet parsing or unrelated state.
The class implements the R314 InterfaceWidgetRenderCallback contract and receives the concrete RSInterface plus resolved x/y coordinates from R302 InterfaceRenderer.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the widget decoration callback owned exclusively by HalloweenEventChestOverlay. The decoration's product meaning is not narrowed beyond what the draw behavior proves.

evidence.detail: The class is a synthetic child of the already-reviewed rs/l/e/a/o HalloweenHungerGamesOverlay; its constructor takes only that parent and no other exact-v308 owner constructs it.
HalloweenHungerGamesOverlay registers this callback across the exact contiguous widget set 18038 through 18044 through the ClientOverlay widget-callback registry.

The callback draws the parent overlay's shared rs/l/F N sprite at fixed offsets from the resolved widget coordinates, with one offset branch for widget ids below 18041 and another for ids 18041 and above.
The class implements the R314 InterfaceWidgetRenderCallback contract and owns no independent packet, lifecycle or cross-domain state.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the widget decoration callback owned exclusively by HalloweenHungerGamesOverlay. The sprite's narrower visual meaning is intentionally not guessed.
